about: Permanent regression set for the Dizi identity engine: the 24 shows that the old title/slug logic could not match (loose Arabic translations, alternative/renamed Turkish titles, glued slugs, TV programs). The engine must keep resolving them to these TMDB ids from scratch (node scripts/poster-pick.mjs --testset), and must NEVER pick a wrong one for the unresolved ones.
